top_signals.title: Stocks Edge Up With Treasuries, Crude Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks edged higher as investors rotated out of the artificial intelligence trade ahead of key tech earnings this week that will offer clues on whether the recent pullback has further to run. Treasuries rose and oil declined.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: World Is on Track for Up to 2.8 Degrees of Warming Despite Clean Energy Boom
top_signals.summary: The United Nations says that it is now an inevitability that the world will fail to meet the legally binding goals set forth by the Paris climate accord as a result of “decades of insufficient climate action”. The Paris Agreement, ratified in 2015, targeted limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial averages, with a fallback target of 2?, with the understanding that this looser allowance would lead to far more devastating consequences for global ecosystems, human health, the economy, and future generations.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
